title: %set - overwrite an accumulator with a value
purpose: Replace a named accumulator's current value on each loop pass, ending with the last record's value.
notes: Unlike %accumulate, %set replaces rather than adds; after a loop the accumulator holds the last record's value.
Supports any value type (string or number), not just numerics.
The accumulator must be declared in {$accumulator} with _persist = true; the first argument names it.

avoid.why: %set is a no-op on an undeclared accumulator and returns ~, so the read-back yields ~ instead of the value
